challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I have been tracking the operational overhead of our weekly retraining cycles, and the manual trigger remains a significant bottleneck for the team. Every time a model update requires a human to initiate the job, we lose valuable hours that could be spent on feature engineering or performance tuning. I want the retraining trigger to be fully automated so that the system updates itself based on data drift thresholds without any manual intervention. The more we can remove human steps from this pipeline, the more efficient our operations become. This automation is essential for scaling our forecasting capabilities across all regions without increasing headcount.
output.reclassify_reason: The text expresses a strong desire to remove manual steps to improve efficiency and scale without headcount, indicating that exceeding the basic request for automation by achieving full autonomy would make the author happier.
